plain_text:
City of Bristol 
BRISTOL, CONNECTICUT  06010 
 
REAL ESTATE COMMITTEE 
MINUTES 
MEETING OF TUESDAY SEPTEMBER 8, 2026 
5:30 P.M. 
 
CALL TO ORDER: 
  
By:  Chairman Hahn    Time: 5:30 pm  Place:    City Hall  
          111 North Main Street 
          Meeting Room 1-1 
 
 NAME PRESENT ABSENT 
MEMBERS Councilman Greg Hahn, Chairperson X  
 Councilman Erick Rosengren (via zoom) X  
 Councilman Mark Dickau  X   
 
The following were in attendance also: Marco Palmeri, Jeffrey Steeg, Maria Theam, Attorney James 
Ziogas, Phil and Joanne Caron. 
 
The Call to Order was followed by the Pledge of Allegiance.   
 
1. Administrative Matters 
a. Approval of Minutes –   8/3/2026 Regular Hearing  
 
MOTION: To approve the minutes of the Regular Meeting of August 3, 2026. 
 
BY:  Councilman Dickau     Seconded: Councilman Rosengren. 
 
For:   All in favor 
Against: None 
Abstained: None 
2. Public Participation – Joanne Caron, 425 Burlington Avenue, Bristol –  She appeared before the 
Committee to discuss the proposed subdivision of her property and the possibility of obtaining 
an easement across a City-owned parcel. She requested guidance on the process for obtaining 
the easement. The Committee advised that additional information regarding the City-owned 
property would need to be reviewed and invited her to return at next month’s meeting for 
further discussion.
3. New Business 
a. 99 Main Street: Attorney Ziogas appeared for his client.   
 
MOTION: To refer for 8-24. 
 
BY:  Councilman Dickau     Seconded: Councilman Rosengren 
 
For:   All in favor 
Against: None 
Abstained: None 
b. Lease with the (BBHD) Bristol Burlington Health District (BEALS Senior Community 
Center)   
Dr. Palmeri appeared before the Committee to discuss the lease, which is currently on a 
month-to-month basis. He noted that the exact square footage, including the new and 
rear entrance areas, still needs to be determined. He requested an estimate for a new 
lease and indicated that the current rate is $17.57 per square foot. He would like to 
maintain the current rate, adjusted to account for the additional square footage. 
 
4. Old Business 
a. 81 Church Avenue – Attorney Steeg provided an update regarding the RFP, which has 
a minimum bid of $175,000. Responses are due September 18, 2026, and the results will 
be available following the bid deadline. 
b. List of Possible Encroaching Property Owners on City-Owned Property 
i. 64 Kilmartin Street – Attorney Steeg reported that he spoke with Ryan Heller and Ray 
Rogozinski. Mr. Heller will visit the property to run the property line and determine the 
exact location of the encroachment. Attorney Steeg has not received a response from 
the property owner. 
ii. 93 Tuttle Street – There is nothing to move forward to the City Council at this time. 
c. 135 E. Main Street – Status – Attorney Steeg provided an update and reported that 
the property owner is in the process of closing on a refinance. The process is taking 
longer than anticipated. 
d. Lots 4 and 6 (aka 164) Union Street – The matter was referred for an 8-24 review and 
received a favorable recommendation. Attorney Steeg spoke with Evelyn, who was 
expected to attend the meeting but did not appear. The matter will be placed on next 
month’s agenda. No action was taken. 
e. Lots 6, 7 & 8 Witches Rock Road – An update was received from Purchasing indicating 
that bids are due September 17, 2026. The bid results are expected to be available prior 
to the next meeting.
5. Adjournment:   
MOTION: To Adjourn at 5:58pm 
 
BY:  Councilman Dickau     Seconded: Councilman Rosengren 
 
For:   All in favor 
Against: None 
Abstained: None
